title: CBOE衍生品情报总监：VIX低位与高离散度，市场只关注单家公司风险？
speaker: William

segments.en: I mean, in case the VIX is trading as meetings, right, so VIX is quite low and the markets currently just very, very little macro risk price dim.
segments.zh: 我的意思是，VIX目前处于低位，市场当前对宏观风险的定价非常非常少。

segments.en: That's markets focusing on is really the stock specific risk.
segments.zh: 市场真正关注的是个股特定风险。

segments.en: As a result, you can see the correlation, implied correlation is very, very low levels, tens percent low.
segments.zh: 因此，你可以看到相关性，隐含相关性处于非常低的水平，低至百分之几十。

segments.en: That's very little macro risk price dim.
segments.zh: 这说明宏观风险定价非常少。

segments.en: And if you look at the dispersion, the dispersion is measured by CBO's DSPX index is quite elevated.
segments.zh: 如果你看离散度，由CBOE的DSPX指数衡量的离散度相当高。

segments.en: It's off the July string levels, but remains elevated into the earnings.
segments.zh: 它已从7月的高点回落，但在财报季前仍处于高位。

segments.en: That means markets really looking at the micro stock specific risk.
segments.zh: 这意味着市场真正关注的是微观层面的个股特定风险。

segments.en: And how do I, if I could just toss in the move index here as well because that's the macro?
segments.zh: 我能不能也提一下MOVE指数，因为那是宏观层面的？
